fields.statement: A commit on a run's branch is the run's when it is a merge of the base branch or already on the base branch, carries a Leaf: trailer naming a leaf of the run's change set, a Review: trailer naming the run, or an Actor: trailer naming the actor of one of the run's sessions or the actor the run's own process commits as (its command steps' render and land commits); any other commit added to the branch after the run started is a hand commit, journalled once per commit
fields.wording: (assumed, would have escalated) attribution by the trailers the run's roles already write
